scripts.dev: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler pages dev dist --d1=webapp-production --local --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 5000
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name webapp
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx --yes wrangler d1 migrations apply webapp-production --local
scripts.db:migrate:prod: npx --yes wrangler d1 migrations apply webapp-production
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed
